# Theory of constraints

`customer_support.df.queue_management.theory_of_constraints` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Theory of constraints — find the single step where work actually stops and stop tuning the steps around it.

In support the constraint is almost never first-line; it is a specialist queue, an engineering handoff or one person who knows the legacy system. Improvements anywhere else deliver the work to the bottleneck faster and change nothing the customer can feel.
